## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A two-fascicle early-Qīng commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng* by **Dé Yù** 德玉 ([德玉](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BE%B7%E7%8E%89)). 順硃 *shùnzhū* "vermilion-marked" indicates a commentarial format in which the parent text is presented with red-ink (硃 = 朱) marginal annotations.

**Abstract**

The *shùnzhū* genre — sūtra texts with red-ink commentarial annotation — was a popular early-Qīng format for the practical study of canonical texts. Dé Yù's *Fànwǎng* edition presents the bodhisattva-precept text with concise marginal explanations suited to instructional and devotional use.
